description: Stable error codes. Clients branch on `code` (and `sub_code`), never on text. `status` is how a Commit reports it. Checked against the code by core/tests/schemas.rs.

codes.meaning: Input does not match the type's schema.
The operation is malformed or not allowed in this state.
A size, count or depth limit was exceeded.
The target does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does.
The target was deleted; a late write never resurrects it.
A reference target is missing, or the entity is still referenced.
The trusted principal lacks the capability.
A version cell changed since the caller read it.
The write is based on a field type that changed.
The idempotency key was used with a different request.
Format, storage, schema or protocol version is not supported.
The content needs a type or selector this build does not have.
An asset, object or data source is not available.
Storage is full; nothing was saved.
Storage failed; nothing was saved.
The Workspace writer is busy or was reset.
A rich text update depends on operations the backend does not have; catch up and resend.
The change stream or collaboration history no longer covers the caller's base; prepare the replica again.
The Workspace history was replaced by a restore; seq, rev and idempotency keys of the old epoch are void.
The source changed during consistent paging.
The commit contains operations the backend cannot compensate.
The processing run this commit belongs to was cancelled.
The target needs a write lock the caller does not hold.
The lock is held by another session.
The caller's lease expired, was idle-released or was broken.
